results.content: Sound transmission class Sound Transmission Class (STC) is an integer rating of how well a building partition attenuates airborne sound . In the US, it is widely used to rate interior partitions, ceilings, floors, doors, windows and exterior wall configurations. Outside the US, the ISO Sound Reduction Index (SRI) is used.
